documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018
Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter

analysis.summary: Silkflex Polymers held its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call, highlighting the commencement of full-scale commercial production at its Vadodara facility. Management reported strong financial growth for the fourth quarter and full year, driven by operating leverage, cost control, and the transition toward in-house manufacturing of textile binders and table glue. The company outlined priorities for FY2027, including scaling manufacturing utilization to 100%, shifting the revenue mix further toward manufacturing, and expanding binder applications into non-textile industries. Silkflex Polymers reported its financial performance for the fourth quarter and full year of fiscal 2026, highlighting growth in revenue, EBITDA, and profit after tax. Management detailed the successful transition from a trading model to a manufacturing-led model following the commissioning of its automated facility in Vadodara, Gujarat.

guidance.claim: The company expects to reach full capacity utilization of its Vadodara plant by the end of financial year 2027.
guidance.quote: So, we are expecting to reach full capacity utilization, by the end of financial year '27.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates that overall EBITDA margins can increase by 200 to 300 basis points overall.
guidance.quote: So overall EBITDA can increase by 200-300 basis points. If seen overall, we can expect expansion by 2% to 3%.

guidance.claim: The company targets a manufacturing and trading revenue contribution mix of 50%-50% going forward.
guidance.quote: Right now, . Like it is in trading and manufacturing right now what we did as of now was 75%-25% that will become 50%-50% .

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve full capacity at its plant by the next financial year.
guidance.quote: By looking the demand across the market by next financial year, we will achieve full capacity that we are hoping.

guidance.claim: The company expects manufacturing margins to reach near about 50% in the coming time.
guidance.quote: Currently our margin in manufacturing is around 25%. And in the coming time, we can expect margins to be near about 50% according to the production.

guidance.claim: The company expects 15% to 20% growth in the textile ink market and 20% to 30% growth in the wood coating market.
guidance.quote: Rohan, now both the segments are growing exceptionally and I am looking for 15% to 20% in the ink market in the textile market, I mean to say. And for the wood coating market it will be more like 20% to 30% in wood coating.

guidance.claim: The company aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company by 2030.
guidance.quote: By 2030, Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company supported by one of India's most advanced and sustainable textile coating facilities.

demand_outlook.claim: The near-term export environment remains somewhat cautious due to global macro uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics.
demand_outlook.quote: From a demand standpoint, the near-term export environment remains somewhat cautioned due to global macro uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is receiving a very good response in the domestic market for wood coating due to increasing awareness of solvent-free solutions.
demand_outlook.quote: So, we are getting a very good response in that too. Because now, there is a lot of awareness to get out of solvents in the market. Looking to the global situation as well as the pressure from the government. So, people are looking for solvent-free solutions. And where we are getting very good business as a domestic player.

demand_outlook.claim: India's textile and apparel industry is expected to maintain strong sustainable growth driven by domestic consumption and exports.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, India's textile and apparel industry is expected to maintaining strong sustainable growth supporting by rising the domestic consumption and expanding export opportunities.

demand_outlook.claim: The paints and coating market is seeing accelerated adoption of water-based and speciality formulations.
demand_outlook.quote: At the same time, the paints and coating market, particularly water-based and speciality formulations, align with our core segments, is witnessing accelerated adoption driven by sustainability performance and prompt technical services as well as regulatory preferences.

demand_outlook.claim: There is growing demand for sustainable wood coating across furniture, interior, and decorative applications.
demand_outlook.quote: Secondly, in the coating segment, the growing demand for sustainable wood coating across furniture, interior, and decorative applications make our premium water-based polymer range increasing essentially.

demand_outlook.claim: India has emerged as a preferred destination for garment and fabric sourcing due to challenges in Bangladesh and the China Plus One strategy.
demand_outlook.quote: The China Plus One strategy has gained momentum and with Bangladesh facing challenges such as power disruptions, political unrest, rising production cost, and stricter compliances requirements, India has emerged as a preferred destination for garment and fabric sourcing.

capex_expansion.claim: The Vadodara plant facility is spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet automated setup and an installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month.
capex_expansion.quote: The Facility is spread over 10 acres of land with 72,000 square feet automated setup and the plant has been installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month and operates on a boiler-less, zero-carbon and zero-discharge model, aligned with our sustainability which is the first philosophy.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is in the process of adding new machinery over the next couple of months funded through internal resources.
capex_expansion.quote: Additionally, we are in the process of adding new machinery over the next couple of months, funded through our internal resources, which will enable us to expand our product portfolio and enter adjacent categories as well.

capex_expansion.claim: Future manufacturing capacity expansion through putting up new vessels will cost approximately INR3 crore to INR5 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: We have furthermore scope of putting up the vessels, which will be costing near about INR3 crore, INR4 crore, INR5 crores, and we can expand our manufacturing capacity as well according to the requirements.

capex_expansion.claim: The company commissioned a state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara.
capex_expansion.quote: Commissioned a state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara, marking the company’s strategic shift from trading to a manufacturing-led model to enhance margins, scalability, and operational control.

capex_expansion.claim: Silkflex has commenced commercial production at its first manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat.
capex_expansion.quote: I am pleased to share that this quarter marks a significant milestone for Silkflex Polymers India Limited with the commencement of commercial production at our first manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has planned an expansion within the next six months to potentially make domestic binders or ink.
capex_expansion.quote: We have planned our expansion within the next 6 months because we will also make domestic binders or based on our discussions, we can also make ink in the coming time.

capex_expansion.claim: The Vadodara facility is designed to produce Silkbond 35 Binder and Silkflex Glue with an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.
capex_expansion.quote: Spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet state-of-the-art automated plant, the facility is designed to produce our flagship products, Silkbond 35 Binder & Silkflex Glue, with an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.

capex_expansion.claim: The factory setup already includes utility, cooling plant, and monomer storage capacity installed for further expansion without requiring more capex.
capex_expansion.quote: We already set up our factory in a major factors like, you can say utility, cooling plant, monomer storage capacity, already we have been instaledl according to the expansion capacity for the further expansion. So we need not require for more capex.

margins_costs.claim: Backward integration is expected to improve EBITDA margins by approximately 20% to 25%.
margins_costs.quote: With this backward integration is expected to improve EBITDA margins by approximately 20% to 25%, reduce our import dependency and enhance supply reliability.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material costs saw a sharp increase during the year driven by global supply disruptions and geopolitical factors.
margins_costs.quote: To put this in perspective, raw materials saw a sharp increase during the year, largely driven by global supply disruptions and geopolitical factors.

margins_costs.claim: Proactive inventory strategy helped secure raw materials at favorable blended costs to provide near-term margin stability.
margins_costs.quote: However, our proactive inventory strategy has helped us secure raw materials at favourable blended costs, which should provide margin stability over the near term.

margins_costs.claim: Manufacturing segment EBITDA margins are around 20% to 25%, while the trading business is 12% to 15%.
margins_costs.quote: we can see that the EBITDA margins are around 20%-25% for the manufacturing segment, and for our trading business it is 12% to 15%.

margins_costs.claim: The gross profit margin for Q4 FY26 stood at 33.2%.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Profit Margin (%) 33.2% 39.0% -580 bps 25.0% 820 bps 28.2% 25.8% 240 bps

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for Q4 FY26 was reported at 23.1%.
PAT margin for Q4 FY26 was 11.9%.
EBITDA margin expanded by 1,150 basis points to 21.2% in Q3 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin expanded 1,150 basis points to 21.2% from 9.7% in the quarter 3 from the financial year '25.

margins_costs.claim: The company's reliance on imports has reduced by about 10% to 12% since starting manufacturing.
margins_costs.quote: But still, even though manufacturing has started for these two products, our reliance on imports has reduced by about 10% to 12%.

margins_costs.claim: The company does not expect many changes in raw material price movements based on the last two years.
margins_costs.quote: In the last 2 years, we haven't seen any significant changes. So, we don't expect too many changes in price movements.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization stood at approximately 60% in the first year of operations.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity utilization stood at present approximately 60% in the first year of operations and scaling this remains a key priority for FY2027.

orders_capacity.claim: The current capacity of the plant is 500 metric tons.
orders_capacity.quote: Our current capacity of the plant is 500 metric ton what we have been making the setup.

orders_capacity.claim: The company utilized around 60% capacity in the first two months after starting manufacturing.
orders_capacity.quote: In first 2 months, that is November and December, after starting the manufacturing, we utilized around 60% capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: The Vadodara facility has an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.
orders_capacity.quote: Spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet state-of-the-art automated plant, the facility is designed to produce our flagship products, Silkbond 35 Binder & Silkflex Glue, with an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's term loan is INR 30 crores and working capital is INR 20 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Our term loan is INR30 crores and working capital is INR20 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The land purchase of INR 10 crores was funded through the IPO, with the rest from internal accruals and promoter unsecured loans.
capital_allocation.quote: Out of that INR30 crores is our loan from the bank and so far as the INR20 crores, it was funded through IPO to purchase the land for INR10 crores and the rest of the amount from internal accrual and unsecured loan from promoters.

capital_allocation.claim: The tenure of the long-term loan is 7 years.
The moratorium period for the long-term loan is June 2026.

risks_headwinds.claim: Input costs have remained volatile on the supply side.
risks_headwinds.quote: On the supply side, input costs have remained volatile.

risks_headwinds.claim: Exports were slightly down previously due to the US market.
risks_headwinds.quote: It was a bit down in between due to the US, now it has started, so exports might even increase.
